spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact decodingInfo() algorithm steps: keySystemAccess:null on clear results, ''-vs-null scheme distinction, TypeError for no-tracks/webrtc-with-keySystemConfiguration/malformed MIME/ksc.video-without-video, and InvalidStateError from a real WorkerGlobalScope.

interactive.rationale: Every probe is a button that runs the real call and prints the real observed outcome (resolution values or rejection name/message) against the stated spec expectation, with per-probe and run-all controls.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the clear-vs-encrypted contrast plus honest rejection probing; the page delivers both.

edge_cases.rationale: Six negative/edge probes plus the contrast; the non-probeable SecurityError branch is explicitly labelled as documented-not-demonstrated rather than faked.

references.rationale: Links https://chromestatus.com/feature/4644898109259776 and the decodingInfo() method spec section.

conformance.rationale: Three of the rejection contracts are mirrored as immutable throws-kind assertions in the feature suite and passed on this browser; the scheme-distinction assertions fail honestly pre-152.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Autorun verified in headless Chromium 141 (Playwright/CDP, desktop+mobile): contrast matched spec (clear keySystemAccess:null, encrypted access granted), all four TypeError probes and the Worker InvalidStateError probe reported MATCHES SPEC, console clean; the empty-string probe correctly reported the pre-152 mismatch. No Chrome 152 available; no chrome-devtools-mcp.

telemetry_health.rationale: Per-probe asserts report match/mismatch individually, machinery failures assert false under a distinct id, and the run-all rollup asserts the aggregate.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; probe verdicts use emerald/rose border accents with explicit MATCHES/DOES-NOT-MATCH words on AA-compliant backgrounds.

accessibility.rationale: Probes are a semantic list of native buttons with headings; each observed readout is an aria-live polite region; verdict is conveyed in words, not color alone; focus-visible outlines present.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 with 0px horizontal overflow, full-width tap targets on mobile, both screenshots reviewed.

openQuestions.title: Empty-string probe can only fully match on Chrome 152
openQuestions.detail: On pre-152 browsers the ''-vs-null probe honestly reports DOES NOT MATCH because the member is dropped. Re-verify on Chrome 152 that it flips to MATCHES SPEC, and consider recording per-channel expectations in the critique when 152 reaches stable.

openQuestions.title: SecurityError branch has no live demonstration
openQuestions.detail: The non-secure-context SecurityError rejection cannot be triggered from a secure origin; the page documents it honestly. If the deployment ever serves a plain-http mirror, wire a cross-origin iframe demonstration.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Convey state in text as well as color and route async outcome changes through polite live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each probe's observed line starts with MATCHES SPEC / DOES NOT MATCH in words, is aria-live=polite, and the colored border is reinforcement only.

guidanceConsulted.query: error feedback timing after user interaction
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Surface error/failure feedback tied to the user's action rather than preemptively.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Probes show 'Not run yet' until invoked; rejection details appear only after the user (or the documented autorun hook) runs the probe.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive stacked card list without overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let long tokens wrap and keep grid children min-width safe.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: overflow-wrap:anywhere on observed readouts, breadcrumbs and inline code; probe buttons go full-width under 640px; 0px document overflow verified at 360px.

summary: Contrast plus honest negative testing: on Chromium 141 the clear query returned keySystemAccess:null and the ClearKey cenc query granted access exactly as spec'd; all four TypeError rejections and the Worker InvalidStateError were observed live; the empty-string-scheme probe correctly exposed the pre-152 member-dropped behavior as a mismatch.
